common.tagline: Know where your money is. Know where your wealth is going.

pwa.installTitle: Install Wally on your Home Screen
pwa.installDescription: On iPhone, add Wally from your browser's share menu.
pwa.installStepShare: Tap the Share button in the browser toolbar.
pwa.installStepHome: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then tap Add.
pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of Wally is available.

landing.headline: Your money, all in one clear picture.
landing.subheadline: Track accounts, spending, transfers and investments — and see your true net worth at a glance.

auth.unauthorizedTitle: You don't have access to this page

reports.title: Reports
reports.comingSoon: Income, expense, category and net worth reports will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.baseCurrencyHint: Summaries are recalculated using the latest exchange rate while each account keeps its original currency.
settings.dataPrivacyHint: Export your data or delete your account

settingsData.title: Data & privacy
settingsData.exportHint: Download everything Wally stores about you as a JSON file — accounts, transactions, transfers, categories and portfolios.
settingsData.deleteHint: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone.
settingsData.deleteWarning: This permanently removes your account, all accounts, transactions, transfers, categories and portfolios. There is no recovery.

admin.activeHint: Active = signed in within the last 30 days. Admins never see users' financial data.
admin.comingSoon: Aggregated user statistics will appear here.
